research_target: A recurrent picture state that carries event history through the frozen VLM image interface.
activation_condition: Both technically valid R8 arms fail the unchanged hard8_overfit_learnability_gate.
non_activation_condition: If either valid R8 arm passes hard8, advance the selected R8 law to the fixed full-data pilot and do not run R9.
diagnostic_question: At its original one-eighth raw-mean coefficient, can each fixed recurrent hard8 transition learn in isolation without seven simultaneous segment gradients?

single_changed_variable.name: simultaneous_training_segments
single_changed_variable.r8: Eight independently computed segment gradients are aggregated each optimizer step.
single_changed_variable.r9: One preregistered target segment gradient is computed per independent run and applied as g_target/8.
single_changed_variable.reason: Preserve the target segment's coefficient in the R8 raw mean and avoid an eight-fold gradient advantage.

fixed_contract.updater: DreamLite-mobile U-Net LoRA rank 4; base frozen
fixed_contract.learning_rate_schedule: R5 640-step schedule prefix: 16-step 1e-5 to 3e-5 warmup then cosine toward 1e-5

evaluation.segments: all fixed hard8 segments for every target-trained model
evaluation.reason_all_hard8: Retain valid swap donors and quantify leakage to the seven non-target transitions.

per_target_learnability_gate.bootstrap_ci_reason: There is only one independent target pair unit; resampling four deterministic choice views would imply false independence.

locked_interpretation.8_of_8_pass: Individual representability at the original R8 weight is supported; diagnose realized shared-parameter/optimizer update interference next.
locked_interpretation.1_to_7_pass: Transition heterogeneity is causal; analyze fixed structural properties of failing targets and repair that bottleneck without averaging it away.
locked_interpretation.0_of_8_pass: Batch aggregation is not the bottleneck; reopen recurrent source anchoring and temporal credit assignment against the single-step SET positive control.
locked_interpretation.technical_failure: Rerun only the invalid target in a fresh root and make no scientific inference for it.

formal_success_still_requires: normal better than reset and state swaps
paired uncertainty over independent evaluation units
